title: Document fields
as_of_note: as_of is the case's fixed as-of date.

conventions.source: extracted = read off the document; derived = worked out from fields of the same document
conventions.required: true = must be produced for every document of this type (or when required_when holds)
conventions.amounts: rupees, after applying the statement's unit; computed lines and ratios per column (current, previous year)
conventions.in_app: yes / partly / no, against config/ingestion/document_types.json and config/statements.yaml

documents.name: Certificate of incorporation
documents.issued_by: Registrar of Companies, MCA (Form INC-11; issued through SPICe+)
documents.one_per: Company (a fresh certificate on change of name or conversion)

fields.label: Company name
fields.read_from: Body sentence "I hereby certify that <NAME> is incorporated …"; older layouts label it "Name of Company". The model reads the sentence and the value is confirmed on the page's word index.

fields.label: Corporate Identity Number
fields.read_from: Printed as "Corporate Identity Number (CIN)"; found by scanning the page for the CIN pattern.

fields.label: Date of incorporation
fields.read_from: "Given under my hand at <place> this <day> day of <month> <year>", or "Date of Incorporation". Often written in words; convert to a date.

fields.label: Registered office
fields.read_from: "Mailing Address as per record available in Registrar of Companies office".

fields.label: Company category
fields.read_from: "Company limited by shares", "private company" wording in the certificate body.

fields.label: Registrar of Companies office
fields.read_from: "Office of the Registrar of Companies, <city>".

fields.label: PAN allotted with incorporation
fields.read_from: SPICe+ certificates print "The Permanent Account Number (PAN) of the company is …".

fields.label: TAN allotted with incorporation
fields.read_from: "Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN)": four letters, five digits, one letter.

fields.label: Original or fresh certificate
fields.read_from: Heading "Certificate of Incorporation" against "Fresh Certificate of Incorporation Consequent upon Change of Name" (or upon conversion).

fields.label: Former name
fields.read_from: Printed only on a fresh certificate after a change of name.

sections.name: Worked out from what is read

fields.label: Industry (NIC 2008)
fields.formula: CIN[1:6], the 5-digit NIC code, mapped to a sector

fields.label: Company class
fields.formula: CIN[12:15]: PTC private limited, PLC public limited, OPC one person, NPL section 8, FTC/FLC foreign subsidiary, GOI/SGC government

fields.label: Business vintage
fields.formula: completed months from date_of_incorporation to as_of ÷ 12

documents.name: Memorandum and Articles of Association
documents.issued_by: The company (Companies Act 2013 s.4, s.5; Schedule I Tables A to F)

sections.name: Memorandum (clauses I to V and subscription)

fields.label: Name clause
fields.read_from: Clause I: "The name of the company is <X> PRIVATE LIMITED."

fields.label: CIN
fields.read_from: Only on certified or updated copies (header or stamp). A memorandum is signed before incorporation, so the original carries none.

fields.label: Registered office State
fields.read_from: Clause II: "The registered office of the company will be situated in the State of <X>."

fields.label: Main objects
fields.read_from: Clause III(A) "MAIN OBJECTS TO BE PURSUED …" up to III(B); may span pages.

fields.label: Liability clause
fields.read_from: Clause IV: "The liability of the member(s) is limited …" (by shares or by guarantee).

fields.label: Authorised capital
fields.read_from: Clause V: "The authorised share capital of the company is Rs. <X> divided into <n> equity shares of Rs. <f> each".

fields.label: Face value per share
fields.read_from: Clause V, "… shares of Rs. <f> each".

fields.label: Paid-up capital
fields.read_from: Where an amended copy states it. The current figure is share capital in the audited balance sheet.

fields.label: Subscribers
fields.read_from: Subscription clause table "Name, address, description and occupation of subscriber", one row per subscriber.

fields.label: Shares taken by each subscriber
fields.read_from: Same table, "No. of shares" column; skip the Total row.

fields.label: First directors (name, DIN)
fields.read_from: Article "The first directors of the company are …"; one entry per person, title removed, DIN when printed.

fields.label: Borrowing powers article
fields.read_from: Article headed "Borrowing powers": whether the Board may borrow, and any cap, condition or need for members' approval.

fields.label: Private-company restrictions
fields.read_from: Definition article: transfer of shares restricted, members capped at 200, no invitation to the public (s.2(68)).

fields.label: Date of the latest alteration
fields.read_from: Notes beside altered clauses: "Altered vide special resolution dated …".

documents.name: Board resolution authorising the facility
documents.issued_by: The company: certified true copy signed by a director or the company secretary

fields.label: Company
fields.read_from: "… Board of Directors of <X> (CIN …)" in the heading.

fields.label: CIN in the heading
fields.read_from: Usually printed in brackets after the name.

fields.label: Date of the Board meeting
fields.read_from: "… held on <weekday>, <dd Month yyyy>".

fields.label: Place of the meeting
fields.read_from: "… at the registered office of the company at …".

fields.label: Resolution date
fields.read_from: Only where printed apart from the meeting date (a "Date:" line on the certification).

fields.label: Resolution number
fields.read_from: "Resolution No. …" where printed.

fields.label: Lender
fields.read_from: "… to borrow from <Lender>, credit facilities …".

fields.label: Borrowing limit
fields.read_from: "… aggregating to Rs. <amount>"; the amount only.

fields.label: Facilities authorised
fields.read_from: "… cash credit of Rs …, term loan of Rs …".

fields.label: Purpose
fields.read_from: The purpose as stated ("working capital"); a heading is not a purpose.

fields.label: Security to be created
fields.read_from: "… to create hypothecation / charge / mortgage over …".

fields.label: Authorised signatories
fields.read_from: The people authorised to sign or execute the loan documents; one entry per person, no titles.

fields.label: Directors named
fields.read_from: "Shri <Name>, Director" lines.

fields.label: DINs of the directors named
fields.read_from: "(DIN 12345678)" after each name, in the same order.

fields.label: Certified by (name, designation, DIN)
fields.read_from: Certification block: "Certified true copy … For <Company> … Director (DIN …)".

fields.label: Signed
fields.read_from: Blank after "Signature:" or "Name:" means unsigned (validator signature_block_filled).

fields.label: Stamped
fields.read_from: Blank after "Stamp:", "Seal:" or "Company seal:" means unstamped (validator stamp_block_filled).

documents.name: Audited financial statements
documents.issued_by: The company, audited under Companies Act s.143; Schedule III format; filed with the Registrar in AOC-4
documents.one_per: Financial year: two checklist items, one per year

fields.label: Entity name
fields.read_from: Auditor's report heading or opinion ("… of X PRIVATE LIMITED").

fields.label: Year end of the current column
fields.read_from: "Balance sheet as at 31 March 2026", "for the year ended …", or XBRL "Date of end of reporting period".

fields.label: Year end of the comparative column
fields.formula: financial_year − 12 months (confirm on the column heading)

fields.label: Unit of every amount
fields.read_from: "All amounts in INR thousands", "(Rs. in lakhs)", XBRL "Level of rounding". Absent means rupees.

fields.label: Unit multiplier
fields.formula: from amount_unit: rupees 1; thousands 1,000; lakhs 1,00,000; millions 10,00,000; crores 1,00,00,000

fields.label: Audited, provisional or projected
fields.read_from: Title, a "Provisional" or "Projected" heading, and whether an auditor's report is attached.

fields.label: Indian GAAP or Ind AS
fields.read_from: Basis of preparation note (Schedule III Division I or II).

fields.label: Audit firm
fields.read_from: Signature block of the auditor's report; XBRL "Name of audit firm".

fields.label: Firm registration number
fields.read_from: "Firm Registration No. 123456W".

fields.label: Signing partner's membership number
fields.read_from: "Membership No. 123456".

fields.label: UDIN
fields.read_from: "UDIN: …" after the membership number: 18 characters.

fields.label: Date of the auditor's report
fields.read_from: "Place: … | Date: …" under the auditor's signature; XBRL "Date of signing audit report".

fields.label: Audit opinion
fields.read_from: Heading of the opinion paragraph: Opinion (unmodified), Qualified Opinion, Adverse Opinion, Disclaimer of Opinion.

fields.label: Going-concern uncertainty
fields.read_from: Paragraph "Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern".

fields.label: CARO 2020 adverse remarks
fields.read_from: Annexure to the auditor's report: default in repayment (clause ix), unpaid statutory dues (vii), fraud (xi).

fields.read_from: Balance sheet, row "Other non-current assets"; current and previous columns, × unit multiplier.

fields.read_from: Balance sheet, row "Current investments"; current and previous columns, × unit multiplier.

fields.read_from: Balance sheet, row "Inventories" (also printed as Closing stock; Stock-in-trade); current and previous columns, × unit multiplier.

sections.name: Worked out from what is read

fields.label: Months covered
fields.formula: calendar months from statement_period_start to statement_period_end, merged across the account's files

fields.label: Category of each entry
fields.formula: category of each transactions.description: first matching rule in config/txn_classification.yaml, then the model, then a person

fields.label: Business credits by month
fields.formula: Σ transactions.credit per month, less own-account transfers, loan disbursals, reversals and returned cheques (by txn_category)

fields.label: Average balance by month
fields.formula: mean of the end-of-day transactions.balance over every calendar day of the month (carried forward over days with no entry)

fields.label: Instalments by lender
fields.formula: transactions.debit to one lender in 3 or more months, amounts within 5%

fields.label: Cheques and auto-debits returned
fields.formula: count of transactions with txn_category = return_issued (the borrower's own cheques or auto-debits returned unpaid; events, not charge lines)

fields.label: Cash-deposit share
fields.formula: Σ transactions.credit with txn_category = cash_deposit ÷ Σ transactions.credit × 100, per month

fields.label: CC/OD utilisation
fields.required_when: the account is cash credit or overdraft
fields.formula: average daily drawn transactions.balance ÷ min(sanctioned_limit, drawing_power) × 100

fields.label: Days overdrawn
fields.required_when: the account is cash credit or overdraft
fields.formula: days the drawn transactions.balance exceeded min(sanctioned_limit, drawing_power)
